CHAIRMAN’S REVIEW
Dear Members,
It is my distinct pleasure to welcome you all to the 2nd Annual General Meeting of Zameen REIT
Management Company Limited.
The Company is moving in line with its vision and achieving its mission. Further, we successfully
closed our financial year ending June 30, 2025. Looking ahead, the Company is focused on
introducing new Schemes to drive growth. To achieve this, the Company is exploring strategic
opportunities for launching REIT Schemes, underscoring its commitment to innovation and business
expansion. The Company has been complying with the Listed Companies (Code of Corporate
Governance) Regulations, 2019. The Company has constituted two committees i.e., Audit & Risk
Oversight Committee, which reports to the Board and Legal & Compliance Committee, which
reports to the senior management & these committees are performing their functions diligently.
The Chief Executive Officer of the Company has been delivering his duties with best of his abilities.
The Board’s expert direction has been instrumental in shaping our policy decisions, and I
appreciate the dedication of each member in fulfilling their obligations. My fellow board members
deserve special recognition for their unwavering commitment and valuable insights that have
significantly impacted our progress. On behalf of the Board, I extend our heartfelt appreciation to
the Government of Pakistan, specifically the Ministry of Finance, Securities and Exchange
Commission of Pakistan, and Federal Board of Revenue, for their unwavering support. Last but not
least, I’d like to recognize the tireless efforts of our management team, whose dedication has
been instrumental in our success.

Zeeshan Ali Khan
Chairman
